content:
Compute the lcm of all numbers \(1,\dots,9\) except \(5\):
\[
\operatorname{lcm}(1,2,3,4,6,7,8,9)=504.
\]
The smallest multiple of \(504\) greater than \(2000\) is
\[
504\cdot 4=2016.
\]
Checking other possible missing divisors gives candidates at least \(2160\) or \(2520\), so none are smaller.

\[
\boxed{2016}
\]
